name: Apache Maven Doxia — Module system map
description: Hand-authored module-level CALM for apache/maven-doxia. Grain is Maven module boundaries (not HTTP services). Doxia is a content parsing/rendering framework (Parser → Sink), not a deployable web app. Independent of the platform generator. Source: https://github.com/apache/maven-doxia

metadata.value: Top-level Maven modules + format plugins under doxia-modules; key dependency connects from poms
Class-level Parser/Sink graph; SPI/Plexus wiring; flexmark third-party graph; tests; doxia-test-docs content
No JAX-RS/Spring HTTP entry points and no JPA/SQL persistence in this codebase — fintech HTTP/DB claims are N/A; this package stresses library/module monorepo shape.

nodes.name: Apache Maven Doxia
nodes.description: Multi-module content generation framework: parse document formats into a Sink event stream.

nodes.name: doxia-sink-api
nodes.description: Public Sink / SinkFactory API (event consumer contracts for document generation).

nodes.name: doxia-core
nodes.description: Core Doxia facade (DefaultDoxia), ParserManager, base parsers/sinks, macros. Depends on doxia-sink-api (pom).

nodes.name: doxia-modules
nodes.description: Aggregator for format-specific parser/sink modules (apt, fml, xdoc, xhtml5, markdown).

nodes.name: doxia-module-markdown
nodes.description: Markdown format parser/sink module (Flexmark-based). Depends on doxia-module-xhtml5 (pom).

relationships.description: Doxia product is composed of sink-api, core, modules aggregator, and format modules.
doxia-core Maven dependency on doxia-sink-api (pom artifactId doxia-sink-api).
Format modules plug into core Parser/Sink abstractions (architectural dependency on doxia-core APIs).
